note: The 2D design view gains dimensional rulers along the top and left (in your length unit, tracking zoom and pan, carried into the SVG/PNG exports) and a roll slider on the far left that turns the rocket about its long axis, shared with the Aft view - both asked for on the beta thread. The side view now foreshortens each fin by its clock angle the way desktop OpenRocket does, so a three-fin set draws one full-span fin up and two half-span down instead of a mirrored pair; four-fin sets are unchanged. The Aft view's pods and clusters, which sat 90 degrees away from the fins, now share the fins' zero angle. No physics changed - every simulation gives v0.077's numbers exactly.
